blocks.text: It does not require the supreme consciousness to move through physical space.
blocks.directed: It does not require the supreme consciousness to move through physical space.

blocks.directed: The same divine power that permits contraction also permits the overcoming of contraction.

blocks.text: And because consciousness is ultimately free, the intensity and mode of its liberating manifestation are not completely reducible to a fixed sequence of human actions.

blocks.directed: In the text's metaphysics, that principle is the supreme consciousness.

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: But does the ego become ruler of the goddesses?
blocks.directed: But does the ego become ruler of the goddesses?

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: No.
blocks.directed: No.

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: Absolutely not.
blocks.directed: [short pause] Absolutely not.

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: This is exactly where careless readings go catastrophically wrong.
blocks.directed: This is exactly where careless readings go catastrophically wrong.

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: The empirical ego might say:
blocks.directed: [short pause] The empirical ego might say:

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: “Excellent. I have learned that I am the Lord of the Śākinīs. Please inform the universe that all departments now report directly to me.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “Excellent. I have learned that I am the Lord of the Śākinīs. Please inform the universe that all departments now report directly to me.”

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: That is not recognition.
blocks.directed: That is not recognition.

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: That is an exceptionally elaborate personality disorder wearing a Sanskrit costume.
blocks.directed: That is an exceptionally elaborate personality disorder wearing a Sanskrit costume.

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: The distinction concerns the finite subject's identification.
blocks.directed: The distinction concerns the finite subject's identification.

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: Ordinarily, the person identifies as a restricted knower.
blocks.directed: Ordinarily, the person identifies as a restricted knower.

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: Through recognition, they discover the universal consciousness that grounds both their own experience and the differentiated divine powers.
blocks.directed: Through recognition, they discover the universal consciousness that grounds both their own experience and the differentiated divine powers.

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: The resulting lordship belongs to that universal consciousness.
blocks.directed: The resulting lordship belongs to that universal consciousness.

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: It is not an unlimited new personal privilege acquired by the finite ego.
blocks.directed: It is not an unlimited new personal privilege acquired by the finite ego.

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: What does yogaṃ vināpi mean?
blocks.directed: What does yogaṃ vināpi mean?

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: The verse explicitly says:
blocks.directed: [short pause] The verse explicitly says:

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: योगं विनापि हि - yogaṃ vināpi hi.
blocks.directed: [slowly] योगं विनापि हि - yogaṃ vināpi hi.

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: “Even without yoga.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “Even without yoga.”

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: But which yoga?
blocks.directed: But which yoga?

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: Abhinavagupta explains that the person need not rely on ābhyāsika yoga, yoga constituted through repeated practice, or on the condition of identity that is attained only after the fall of the Māyic body.
blocks.directed: Abhinavagupta explains that the person need not rely on ābhyāsika yoga, yoga constituted through repeated practice, or on the condition of identity that is attained only after the fall of the Māyic body.

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: This is a striking contrast between a gradual practice-dependent model and immediate recognition.
blocks.directed: This is a striking contrast between a gradual practice-dependent model and immediate recognition.

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: The higher realisation does not require the body to die.
blocks.directed: The higher realisation does not require the body to die.

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: Nor does it necessarily require prolonged preparatory yogic procedures.
blocks.directed: Nor does it necessarily require prolonged preparatory yogic procedures.

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: But do not misread this as a universal instruction that no one should practise.
blocks.directed: But do not misread this as a universal instruction that no one should practise.

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: The sentence concerns a person who has already attained the relevant knowledge through supreme grace.
blocks.directed: The sentence concerns a person who has already attained the relevant knowledge through supreme grace.

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: For that person, the ultimate identity is not something awaiting production by further practice.
blocks.directed: For that person, the ultimate identity is not something awaiting production by further practice.

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: The difference is between practice as a possible means of recognition and practice as an alleged creator of the supreme Self.
blocks.directed: The difference is between practice as a possible means of recognition and practice as an alleged creator of the supreme Self.

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: The latter is impossible in this metaphysics.
blocks.directed: The latter is impossible in this metaphysics.

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: The supreme Self is not a product.
blocks.directed: The supreme Self is not a product.

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: The great philosophical paradox
blocks.directed: The great philosophical paradox

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: If the supreme consciousness is already present, why do people not ordinarily recognise it?
blocks.directed: If the supreme consciousness is already present, why do people not ordinarily recognise it?

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: Because its freedom includes the power of contraction.
blocks.directed: Because its freedom includes the power of contraction.

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: The limitation is not ultimately an external force capable of overpowering Śiva.
blocks.directed: The limitation is not ultimately an external force capable of overpowering Śiva.

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: It is a mode of manifestation.
blocks.directed: It is a mode of manifestation.

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: The finite subject experiences itself through that limitation.
blocks.directed: The finite subject experiences itself through that limitation.

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: When recognition arises, the underlying identity is disclosed.
blocks.directed: When recognition arises, the underlying identity is disclosed.

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: But the identity was not absent beforehand.
blocks.directed: But the identity was not absent beforehand.

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: That is why the highest śaktipāta can produce recognition without a gradual construction of the Self.
blocks.directed: That is why the highest śaktipāta can produce recognition without a gradual construction of the Self.

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: And that is why yogaṃ vināpi has such philosophical force.
blocks.directed: And that is why yogaṃ vināpi has such philosophical force.

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: The person is not liberated because they have successfully completed the longest practice.
blocks.directed: The person is not liberated because they have successfully completed the longest practice.

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: They are liberated through recognition of the nature that makes practice, experience, and knowledge possible in the first place.
blocks.directed: They are liberated through recognition of the nature that makes practice, experience, and knowledge possible in the first place.

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: Now Abhinavagupta says:
blocks.directed: [short pause] Now Abhinavagupta says:

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: किं च - kiṃ ca.
blocks.directed: [slowly] किं च - kiṃ ca.

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: “And furthermore.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “And furthermore.”

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: Because apparently becoming the lord of the Śākinī circle is not enough.
blocks.directed: Because apparently becoming the lord of the Śākinī circle is not enough.

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: We are now going to discover that someone who doesn't know the rules of worship can become a knower of worship.
blocks.directed: We are now going to discover that someone who doesn't know the rules of worship can become a knower of worship.

blocks.section: VIII. Śākinīkulasāmānya: The Common Vibration Beneath the En
blocks.text: And the explanation involves a particularly merciless joke about ignorance.
blocks.directed: And the explanation involves a particularly merciless joke about ignorance.

blocks.text: It is the nature of the subject itself.
blocks.directed: It is the nature of the subject itself.

blocks.section: XIV. The Great Return: Why the Teacher, the Teaching, and th
blocks.text: The limited subject recognises its identity with universal consciousness.
blocks.directed: The limited subject recognises its identity with universal consciousness.

blocks.section: XIV. The Great Return: Why the Teacher, the Teaching, and th
blocks.text: The knowing is therefore reflexive.
blocks.directed: The knowing is therefore reflexive.

blocks.section: XIV. The Great Return: Why the Teacher, the Teaching, and th
blocks.text: The supreme subject is not objectified as something standing elsewhere.
blocks.directed: The supreme subject is not objectified as something standing elsewhere.

blocks.section: XIV. The Great Return: Why the Teacher, the Teaching, and th
blocks.text: It is the ground of all knowing.
blocks.directed: It is the ground of all knowing.

blocks.section: XIV. The Great Return: Why the Teacher, the Teaching, and th
blocks.text: And the recognition is the disclosure of that ground.
blocks.directed: And the recognition is the disclosure of that ground.

blocks.section: XIV. The Great Return: Why the Teacher, the Teaching, and th
blocks.text: That is why the teacher can be Śiva.
blocks.directed: That is why the teacher can be Śiva.

blocks.section: XIV. The Great Return: Why the Teacher, the Teaching, and th
blocks.text: That is why the knowledge can be initiation.
blocks.directed: That is why the knowledge can be initiation.

blocks.section: XIV. The Great Return: Why the Teacher, the Teaching, and th
blocks.text: That is why the supreme mantra can be the heart.
blocks.directed: That is why the supreme mantra can be the heart.

blocks.section: XIV. The Great Return: Why the Teacher, the Teaching, and th
blocks.text: And that is why someone who has never seen the ritual maṇḍala can nevertheless possess the highest meaning of initiation.
blocks.directed: And that is why someone who has never seen the ritual maṇḍala can nevertheless possess the highest meaning of initiation.

blocks.section: XIV. The Great Return: Why the Teacher, the Teaching, and th
blocks.text: The ceremony may introduce the person to the truth. But the truth is not produced by the ceremony.
blocks.directed: The ceremony may introduce the person to the truth. But the truth is not produced by the ceremony.

blocks.section: XIV. The Great Return: Why the Teacher, the Teaching, and th
blocks.text: And now Abhinavagupta has reached a natural conclusion.
blocks.directed: And now Abhinavagupta has reached a natural conclusion.

blocks.section: XIV. The Great Return: Why the Teacher, the Teaching, and th
blocks.text: He has explained the powers of the supreme heart.
blocks.directed: He has explained the powers of the supreme heart.

blocks.section: XIV. The Great Return: Why the Teacher, the Teaching, and th
blocks.text: He has explained the conditions of recognition.
blocks.directed: He has explained the conditions of recognition.

blocks.section: XIV. The Great Return: Why the Teacher, the Teaching, and th
blocks.text: He has explained how differentiated religious means relate to ultimate knowledge.
blocks.directed: He has explained how differentiated religious means relate to ultimate knowledge.

blocks.section: XIV. The Great Return: Why the Teacher, the Teaching, and th
blocks.text: He has identified the teacher with Śiva.
blocks.directed: He has identified the teacher with Śiva.

blocks.section: XIV. The Great Return: Why the Teacher, the Teaching, and th
blocks.text: And now he announces that he is going to summarise the entire argument.
blocks.directed: And now he announces that he is going to summarise the entire argument.

blocks.section: XIV. The Great Return: Why the Teacher, the Teaching, and th
blocks.text: Not through another extraordinary list of cosmic spheres.
blocks.directed: Not through another extraordinary list of cosmic spheres.

blocks.section: XIV. The Great Return: Why the Teacher, the Teaching, and th
blocks.text: Not through another grammatical investigation of a single consonant.
blocks.directed: Not through another grammatical investigation of a single consonant.

blocks.section: XIV. The Great Return: Why the Teacher, the Teaching, and th
blocks.text: But through a seed.
blocks.directed: But through a seed.

blocks.section: XIV. The Great Return: Why the Teacher, the Teaching, and th
blocks.text: A tiny seed.
blocks.directed: A tiny seed.

blocks.section: XIV. The Great Return: Why the Teacher, the Teaching, and th
blocks.text: Containing an enormous tree.
blocks.directed: Containing an enormous tree.

blocks.section: XIV. The Great Return: Why the Teacher, the Teaching, and th
blocks.text: And through that image, the entire manifest universe.
blocks.directed: And through that image, the entire manifest universe.

blocks.text: KSTS p. 258 - Gnoli p. 275

blocks.section: XV. The Next Authentic Transition: The Banyan Seed and the I
blocks.text: The next sentence is unmistakable:
blocks.directed: [short pause] The next sentence is unmistakable:

blocks.text: एवं विस्तरशोऽभिधाय तात्पर्येण निगमयति ।
blocks.directed: [slowly] एवं विस्तरशोऽभिधाय तात्पर्येण निगमयति ।

blocks.section: XV. The Next Authentic Transition: The Banyan Seed and the I
blocks.text: evaṃ vistaraśo 'bhidhāya tātparyeṇa nigamayati.
blocks.directed: evaṃ vistaraśo 'bhidhāya tātparyeṇa nigamayati.

blocks.section: XV. The Next Authentic Transition: The Banyan Seed and the I
blocks.text: “Having thus explained at length, he now brings the matter to its conclusion according to its essential purport.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “Having thus explained at length, he now brings the matter to its conclusion according to its essential purport.”

blocks.section: XV. The Next Authentic Transition: The Banyan Seed and the I
blocks.text: This is the next substantial authenticated transition, and the natural stopping point for Part XXXI.
blocks.directed: This is the next substantial authenticated transition, and the natural stopping point for Part XXXI.

blocks.section: XV. The Next Authentic Transition: The Banyan Seed and the I
blocks.text: Notice nigamayati.
blocks.directed: Notice nigamayati.

blocks.section: XV. The Next Authentic Transition: The Banyan Seed and the I
blocks.text: It means to conclude, summarise, establish by way of conclusion.
blocks.directed: It means to conclude, summarise, establish by way of conclusion.

blocks.section: XV. The Next Authentic Transition: The Banyan Seed and the I
blocks.text: In this case, the preceding elaborate argument is about to be compressed into a single image.
blocks.directed: In this case, the preceding elaborate argument is about to be compressed into a single image.

blocks.section: XV. The Next Authentic Transition: The Banyan Seed and the I
blocks.text: Abhinavagupta introduces the next verses:
blocks.directed: [short pause] Abhinavagupta introduces the next verses:

blocks.section: XV. The Next Authentic Transition: The Banyan Seed and the I
blocks.text: यथा न्यग्रोधबीजस्थः शक्तिरूपो महाद्रुमः ।
blocks.directed: [slowly] यथा न्यग्रोधबीजस्थः शक्तिरूपो महाद्रुमः ।

blocks.section: XV. The Next Authentic Transition: The Banyan Seed and the I
blocks.text: yathā nyagrodhabījasthaḥ śaktirūpo mahādrumaḥ.
blocks.directed: [slowly] yathā nyagrodhabījasthaḥ śaktirūpo mahādrumaḥ.

blocks.section: XV. The Next Authentic Transition: The Banyan Seed and the I
blocks.text: “Just as a great tree exists in the banyan seed in the form of power…”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “Just as a great tree exists in the banyan seed in the form of power…”

blocks.section: XV. The Next Authentic Transition: The Banyan Seed and the I
blocks.text: Then:
blocks.directed: [short pause] Then:

blocks.section: XV. The Next Authentic Transition: The Banyan Seed and the I
blocks.text: तथा हृदयबीजस्थं जगदेतच्चराचरम् ॥
blocks.directed: [slowly] तथा हृदयबीजस्थं जगदेतच्चराचरम् ॥

blocks.section: XV. The Next Authentic Transition: The Banyan Seed and the I
blocks.text: tathā hṛdayabījasthaṃ jagad etac carācaram.
blocks.directed: tathā hṛdayabījasthaṃ jagad etac carācaram.

blocks.section: XV. The Next Authentic Transition: The Banyan Seed and the I
blocks.text: “So this entire moving and unmoving world exists within the seed of the heart.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “So this entire moving and unmoving world exists within the seed of the heart.”

blocks.section: XV. The Next Authentic Transition: The Banyan Seed and the I
blocks.text: And the following verse announces that genuine knowledge of this relation constitutes an initiation leading to liberation, without the conventional offerings of sesame and clarified butter.
blocks.directed: And the following verse announces that genuine knowledge of this relation constitutes an initiation leading to liberation, without the conventional offerings of sesame and clarified butter.

blocks.section: XV. The Next Authentic Transition: The Banyan Seed and the I
blocks.text: This is the extraordinary conclusion we've been approaching across the entire work. ; ]
blocks.directed: This is the extraordinary conclusion we've been approaching across the entire work. ; ]

blocks.section: XV. The Next Authentic Transition: The Banyan Seed and the I
blocks.text: But the seed analogy deserves its own careful reading.
blocks.directed: But the seed analogy deserves its own careful reading.

blocks.section: XV. The Next Authentic Transition: The Banyan Seed and the I
blocks.text: Because it raises one of the deepest problems in the entire metaphysics.
blocks.directed: Because it raises one of the deepest problems in the entire metaphysics.

blocks.section: XV. The Next Authentic Transition: The Banyan Seed and the I
blocks.text: How can the entire universe be present within something that is not spatially large enough to contain it?
blocks.directed: How can the entire universe be present within something that is not spatially large enough to contain it?

blocks.section: XV. The Next Authentic Transition: The Banyan Seed and the I
blocks.text: What does it mean to say that the banyan tree is already in the seed?
blocks.directed: What does it mean to say that the banyan tree is already in the seed?

blocks.section: XV. The Next Authentic Transition: The Banyan Seed and the I
blocks.text: And what does that analogy establish about the relationship between consciousness and manifestation?
blocks.directed: And what does that analogy establish about the relationship between consciousness and manifestation?

blocks.section: XV. The Next Authentic Transition: The Banyan Seed and the I
blocks.text: If the universe is contained within the heart, is it contained potentially?
blocks.directed: If the universe is contained within the heart, is it contained potentially?

blocks.section: XV. The Next Authentic Transition: The Banyan Seed and the I
blocks.text: Actually?
blocks.directed: Actually?

blocks.section: XV. The Next Authentic Transition: The Banyan Seed and the I
blocks.text: As differentiated powers?
blocks.directed: As differentiated powers?

blocks.section: XV. The Next Authentic Transition: The Banyan Seed and the I
blocks.text: Or in a condition where the distinction between potential and actual has not yet emerged?
blocks.directed: Or in a condition where the distinction between potential and actual has not yet emerged?

blocks.section: XV. The Next Authentic Transition: The Banyan Seed and the I
blocks.text: The Sanskrit will matter enormously.
blocks.directed: The Sanskrit will matter enormously.

blocks.section: XV. The Next Authentic Transition: The Banyan Seed and the I
blocks.text: And so will the difference between a biological seed and the metaphysical hṛdayabīja.
blocks.directed: And so will the difference between a biological seed and the metaphysical hṛdayabīja.

blocks.section: XV. The Next Authentic Transition: The Banyan Seed and the I
blocks.text: Because Abhinavagupta is not claiming that there is a physically tiny universe folded up inside your chest.
blocks.directed: Because Abhinavagupta is not claiming that there is a physically tiny universe folded up inside your chest.

blocks.section: XV. The Next Authentic Transition: The Banyan Seed and the I
blocks.text: He is making a much more sophisticated claim about how differentiation arises from an undivided ground.
blocks.directed: He is making a much more sophisticated claim about how differentiation arises from an undivided ground.

blocks.section: XV. The Next Authentic Transition: The Banyan Seed and the I
blocks.text: And that is exactly where Part XXXII must begin.
blocks.directed: And that is exactly where Part XXXII must begin.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.directed: [long pause] Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: Return to the original question.
blocks.directed: Return to the original question.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: What if you've never seen the maṇḍala?
blocks.directed: What if you've never seen the maṇḍala?

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: What if you haven't received the secret instruction?
blocks.directed: What if you haven't received the secret instruction?

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: What if you don't possess the required ritual qualifications?
blocks.directed: What if you don't possess the required ritual qualifications?

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: What if you have no impressive lineage certificates?
blocks.directed: What if you have no impressive lineage certificates?

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: What if your Sanskrit is imperfect?
blocks.directed: What if your Sanskrit is imperfect?

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: What if you've never experienced a spectacular vision?
blocks.directed: What if you've never experienced a spectacular vision?

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: What if the elaborate machinery of initiation has simply never been made available to you?
blocks.directed: What if the elaborate machinery of initiation has simply never been made available to you?

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: Abhinavagupta's answer is not that those differences never matter.
blocks.directed: Abhinavagupta's answer is not that those differences never matter.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: They may matter within particular religious practices.
blocks.directed: They may matter within particular religious practices.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: They may matter for the acquisition of particular skills.
blocks.directed: They may matter for the acquisition of particular skills.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: They may matter for the transmission of specialised mantras.
blocks.directed: They may matter for the transmission of specialised mantras.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: But they cannot be absolute obstacles to recognition of the supreme reality.
blocks.directed: But they cannot be absolute obstacles to recognition of the supreme reality.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: Because that reality is not manufactured by any of them.
blocks.directed: Because that reality is not manufactured by any of them.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: The ultimate subject was never absent.
blocks.directed: The ultimate subject was never absent.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: The conscious light by which the ceremony would be perceived was already present before the ceremony.
blocks.directed: The conscious light by which the ceremony would be perceived was already present before the ceremony.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: The awareness through which the mantra would be heard was already present before the mantra.
blocks.directed: The awareness through which the mantra would be heard was already present before the mantra.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: The power through which the teacher would be recognised was already present before meeting the teacher.
blocks.directed: The power through which the teacher would be recognised was already present before meeting the teacher.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: The capacity for understanding was not created from nothing by the words of instruction.
blocks.directed: The capacity for understanding was not created from nothing by the words of instruction.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: And the supreme consciousness, in Abhinavagupta's system, is not the property of any restricted human institution.
blocks.directed: And the supreme consciousness, in Abhinavagupta's system, is not the property of any restricted human institution.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: The teacher may reveal it.
blocks.directed: The teacher may reveal it.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: The scripture may explain it.
blocks.directed: The scripture may explain it.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: The mantra may articulate it.
blocks.directed: The mantra may articulate it.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: The ritual may symbolise it.
blocks.directed: The ritual may symbolise it.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: The discipline may prepare the subject for recognition.
blocks.directed: The discipline may prepare the subject for recognition.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: But the reality recognised is not an object acquired from elsewhere.
blocks.directed: But the reality recognised is not an object acquired from elsewhere.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: It is the ground of the entire process.
blocks.directed: It is the ground of the entire process.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: This is why śaktipāta is so important.
blocks.directed: This is why śaktipāta is so important.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: Grace is the disclosure of the supreme nature through consciousness's own freedom.
blocks.directed: Grace is the disclosure of the supreme nature through consciousness's own freedom.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: And this is why the most radical form of initiation can occur without the external ritual.
blocks.directed: And this is why the most radical form of initiation can occur without the external ritual.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: Not because the individual ego has decided to promote itself to divinity.
blocks.directed: Not because the individual ego has decided to promote itself to divinity.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: But because the universal consciousness has become manifest to itself through the contracted subject.
blocks.directed: But because the universal consciousness has become manifest to itself through the contracted subject.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: And now the supreme joke reveals itself.
blocks.directed: And now the supreme joke reveals itself.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: You were searching for consciousness.
blocks.directed: You were searching for consciousness.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: You used consciousness to conduct the search.
blocks.directed: You used consciousness to conduct the search.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: You studied Sanskrit.
blocks.directed: You studied Sanskrit.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: You used consciousness to understand the Sanskrit.
blocks.directed: You used consciousness to understand the Sanskrit.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: You contemplated Śiva.
blocks.directed: You contemplated Śiva.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: You used consciousness to contemplate Śiva.
blocks.directed: You used consciousness to contemplate Śiva.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: You examined your thoughts, sensations, doubts, memories, desires, and acts of recognition.
blocks.directed: You examined your thoughts, sensations, doubts, memories, desires, and acts of recognition.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: Every single one appeared within the field of awareness.
blocks.directed: Every single one appeared within the field of awareness.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: And after the entire investigation, the question is whether the aware reality in which the investigation occurred was ever fundamentally separate from what you were looking for.
blocks.directed: And after the entire investigation, the question is whether the aware reality in which the investigation occurred was ever fundamentally separate from what you were looking for.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: According to Abhinavagupta, it wasn't.
blocks.directed: According to Abhinavagupta, it wasn't.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: You could spend an entire lifetime attempting to reach the supreme subject as though it were a distant object.
blocks.directed: You could spend an entire lifetime attempting to reach the supreme subject as though it were a distant object.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: But the very act of attempting already occurs within consciousness.
blocks.directed: But the very act of attempting already occurs within consciousness.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: The seeker appears within it.
blocks.directed: The seeker appears within it.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: The search appears within it.
blocks.directed: The search appears within it.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: The imagined distance appears within it.
blocks.directed: The imagined distance appears within it.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: And the recognition that the distance was not ultimate also appears within it.
blocks.directed: And the recognition that the distance was not ultimate also appears within it.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: Which is why the highest initiation is not simply an event that turns a nondivine substance into a divine one.
blocks.directed: Which is why the highest initiation is not simply an event that turns a nondivine substance into a divine one.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: It is the disclosure of the nature that was never absent.
blocks.directed: It is the disclosure of the nature that was never absent.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: The ritual might help.
blocks.directed: The ritual might help.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: The teacher might help.
blocks.directed: The teacher might help.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: The scripture might help.
blocks.directed: The scripture might help.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: But the reality to be recognised is the condition of their helping at all.
blocks.directed: But the reality to be recognised is the condition of their helping at all.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: And then comes the final absurdity.
blocks.directed: And then comes the final absurdity.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: You could read a thousand pages explaining how consciousness is the ground of everything.
blocks.directed: You could read a thousand pages explaining how consciousness is the ground of everything.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: You could memorise every Sanskrit quotation.
blocks.directed: You could memorise every Sanskrit quotation.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: You could master the distinction between prakāśa and vimarśa, the structure of the thirty-six tattvas, and the exact phonemic arrangement of the Mātṛkā.
blocks.directed: You could master the distinction between prakāśa and vimarśa, the structure of the thirty-six tattvas, and the exact phonemic arrangement of the Mātṛkā.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: And you could still fail to recognise the subject through which the entire performance was intelligible.
blocks.directed: And you could still fail to recognise the subject through which the entire performance was intelligible.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: A magnificent philosophical achievement.
blocks.directed: A magnificent philosophical achievement.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: The universe has spent several billion years developing the conditions under which a human being can argue about consciousness.
blocks.directed: The universe has spent several billion years developing the conditions under which a human being can argue about consciousness.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: And the human being may still conclude:
blocks.directed: [short pause] And the human being may still conclude:

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: “Very interesting. But where exactly is this awareness thing?”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “Very interesting. But where exactly is this awareness thing?”

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: Abhinavagupta's answer is the most devastatingly simple one imaginable.
blocks.directed: Abhinavagupta's answer is the most devastatingly simple one imaginable.

blocks.section: Closing: The Initiation That Never Had to Happen
blocks.text: Who is asking?
blocks.directed: Who is asking?
